name: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B A9B
short: NVIDIA's open-weight 74B/9B-active Mamba-2 vision-language MoE (256K, IQ2 fits 24GB) for local coding and agentic work; Terminal-Bench 2.1 50.98%, no SWE-bench published.
modalities: Text, image, video in; text out
pricingNote: Open weights (OpenMDW-1.1); runs locally in 24GB, no per-token list price
standout: The 24GB local agent: frontier-shaped Mamba-2 MoE with vision that fits a single desktop GPU at 83.99 tok/s.
tradeoff: The IQ2 24GB build trails BF16 on every quality row, and the agentic evidence is thin - no SWE-bench, LiveCodeBench or DeepSWE figure exists.
